<cite ref="Bava Metzia 116b:20">B. Mets. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>דלית שע״ג פ׳ זה וכ׳</he> I sell thee a grape vine overhanging this peach tree; Y. ib. I, 27ᵃ bot. <he>גוי … ע״ג פ׳</he> a gentile who engrafted a shoot of a nut tree on a peach tree; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="A02833"><he>פַּרְסְקִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="A02833"><he>פַּרְסְקִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:4">Kil. I, 4</cite> <he>הפ׳ והשקדין וכ׳</he> (Bab. ed. <he>השק׳</he>; Ms. M. <he>האפרסקין</he>) peaches (and) almonds … although resembling one another are heterogeneous.
